sources.finding: Reads OOXMLRecalcMode. Mode0 selects DoHardRecalc. With nonzero cached formulas mode1 does not select the no-calculated-cells fallback.
Numeric cached values are imported and dirty state reset. Nonzero values establish calculated-formula presence.
calcMode enables automatic calculation. fullCalcOnLoad and forceFullCalc are absent from importCalcPr; they do not choose the explicit hard-recalc branch here.
Documents Never/Always/Prompt options. Latest-help is explanatory; exact numeric mapping comes from version-pinned source.
